---
title: "Module: `EOSSDK_Metrics`"
---

Tier A. Telemetry — **stubbed no-op** in the emulator. 4 methods.

## Handle & shape
`EOS_HMetrics` via `EOS_Platform_GetMetricsInterface`. `IRunCallback` only. `EmuInit` @`0x18010b5c0` / `EmuDeinit` @`0x18010b8f0`.

## API
- `BeginPlayerSession` @`0x18010b740` (109 B stub), `EndPlayerSession` @`0x18010b7b0` (109 B stub). Both return `EOS_Success` without recording anything (no telemetry endpoint in the emu).

## Reimpl notes
Reimpl: accept and discard. No persistence, no network.
